Private state, metrics, and socket link structures for a UDP socket tile.

# Purpose
This header defines the private state for a socket tile that handles UDP network I/O in hosted builds. It sets limits for the number of sockets and links, and it declares `fd_sock_tile_metrics_t` for local counters such as packet counts, byte counts, and system call counts. It also defines the internal link state types `fd_sock_link_tx_t` and `fd_sock_link_rx_t`, which store buffer pointers and watermark values for transmit and receive paths. The main `fd_sock_tile_t` structure holds the poll set, socket identifiers, batch message buffers, RX and TX link maps, scratch memory, and the metrics block used by the tile.
